Definition: to fold, i.e. duplicate (literally or figuratively); by implication, to transmute (transitive or intransitive)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to repeat, do again, change, alter; 1a) (Qal) to change; 1b) (Niphal) to be repeated; 1c) (Piel) to change, alter; 1d) (Hithpael) to disguise oneself
